statements: SELECT pg_get_viewdef(c.oid,true),pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname='current_ingestion_checkpoints'

SELECT pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid,true) FROM pg_constraint con JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid=con.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND t.relname IN ('alert_episodes','attack_event_classifications')

SELECT pg_get_indexdef(i.oid),pg_get_expr(ind.indpred,ind.indrelid) FROM pg_index ind JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid=ind.indrelid JOIN pg_class i ON i.oid=ind.indexrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND t.relname IN ('alert_episodes','attack_event_classifications')

SELECT p.oid,n.nspname,p.proname,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid),p.provolatile,p.prosecdef,has_function_privilege(current_user,p.oid,'EXECUTE') FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE p.proname IN ('pg_advisory_xact_lock','hashtextextended','gen_random_uuid')
SELECT e.extname,n.nspname,e.extversion FROM pg_extension e JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=e.extnamespace

SELECT c.relname,c.relkind,pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),c.relacl,has_table_privilege(current_user,c.oid,'SELECT'),has_table_privilege(current_user,c.oid,'INSERT'),has_table_privilege(current_user,c.oid,'UPDATE'),has_table_privilege(current_user,c.oid,'DELETE') FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relkind IN ('r','v','S','p')
SELECT r.rolname,r.rolcanlogin,r.rolinherit,r.rolsuper,r.rolcreaterole FROM pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname=current_user OR r.rolname IN ('neondb_owner','authenticated','anonymous')

SELECT a.attname,format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),a.attnotnull,pg_get_expr(ad.adbin,ad.adrelid) FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef ad ON ad.adrelid=c.oid AND ad.adnum=a.attnum WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname='current_ingestion_checkpoints' AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
